items.briefing:
A new report highlights that AI tools, cloud systems, and web applications are increasingly targeted by attackers, with cybercriminals finding new ways to exploit weaknesses faster than organisations can patch them. This is relevant for all Australian training organisations using cloud-based learning platforms or AI-assisted tools. Separately, attacks on a US water utility serve as a reminder that critical infrastructure — including education networks — can be targeted for disruption.

System administrators at Australian organisations are also under growing pressure to manage security risks with limited resources. If your RTO relies on a small IT team, ensure they have clear escalation paths and aren't managing security alone.

**Tip:** Review who has administrator access to your learning management system and remove any accounts that are no longer needed.

featured.title: BreachLock report flags AI, cloud & web logic risks
featured.quote: Every AI system tested showed vulnerabilities, highlighting critical security gaps in production deployments.
